messages:
miriam: Heads up — after today's cutover of our internal routing API (route-hint v2) I noticed the invoice preview is showing weird negative credits for some demo tenants.
aj: which demo tenants? any pattern?
ben: looks tied to requests that used the old `route_id` fallback path. the new hint now sends `route_hint_v2`, but the billing pipeline's enrichment stage doesn't pick it up so we end up counting a fallback SKU -> shows as credit correction later.
miriam: Ugh. That will confuse finance if it hits previews. Are these only in preview mode or also in production invoices?
ben: only preview so far, but the logs show the same missing field in prod canary shards. we should pause rollout or patch the enrich step.
judy: preview-only is better but still noisy. can we add a quick transform in the pre-ingest to map `route_hint_v2` -> legacy `route_id` until billing fully understands it?
aj: yes we can. quick plan: 1) small shim in edge-proxy to populate `route_id_fallback` when `route_hint_v2` present, 2) flag the shim behind `feature:route_hint_compat`, 3) run kelly's preview job to validate invoice deltas.
kelly: I can run a replay on a 2% canary subset and diff invoice-preview. Can we also tag these events with `meta.preview_compat=true` so console can filter them out visually?
ben: tagging is low-risk. I'll open a PR to add `route_id_fallback` and `meta.preview_compat` fields. toggle default off for now.
miriam: timeline?
ben: PR this afternoon, canary tomorrow morning. If results look good we flip the flag and then schedule a quick backfill for the preview indexes.
judy: For accounting's sake, add a little note in the console: "Preview mode: some invoices may be adjusted post-rollout due to routing cutovers". I'll draft wording.
canary-bot: deploy canary job started (job-id: canary-716001). monitor: https://console/internal/jobs/canary-716001 :eyes: 
aj: Also add a metric `billing.enrich.missing_route_hint_v2` so we can alert before it hits preview dashboards.
kelly: On it — will wire the metric and a short dashboard card under Preview > Telemetry.
miriam: Thanks all. If we still see outliers after the shim, we'll pause the cutover and revert to the old routing proxy. :thumbsup: 
judy: FYI finance prefers we don't retroactively adjust paid invoices; previews acceptable. Good call to keep preview isolation.
ben: PR: https://git.redwood/eng-platform/pulls/2345 — review pls.
aj: reviewing now. quick reviews welcome, otherwise I'll queue for merge at 4pm.
